comment: Shared P2-6 set-hash vectors (docs/join-fix-phase2-spec.md). Each file's bytes are exactly content_ascii (ASCII, no BOM, no newline). set_sha256 = SHA-256 over the present slots in ascending order, each contributing u8 slot, u32 size (little-endian) and the raw 32-byte file SHA-256; hex is upper case like Get-FileHash. Consumers: tests/save_handoff_wire_tests.cpp (SetSha256), tests/save_handoff_io_tests.cpp (glue hashing of real files) and tests/friend_package_tests.ps1 (Get-CoopHandoffSetSha256).
